'''Assari''' were a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], several were growing in the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]], a chamber within the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
